title: Chapter 411
text:
The narration of the two commentators sounded at the right time and introduced the battle.

"The two players in this match are Key of Solomon and Mad Blade, Angry Blade. Demon race Mage versus human race Mechanical Pugilist. Key of Solomon is currently ranked seventh, and Mad Blade is ranked eighteenth. The pre-match win rate is estimated to be 57% to 43%. From the performance of the two players in the previous matches, Key of Solomon has the upper hand."

"It can be noted that the venue is Blue Star's Black Phantom Sanctuary Three. The Chinese players are from Blue Star, so Mad Blade should have the advantage of being familiar with the terrain. It is worth mentioning that Black Star was the first person to lead the Chinese players into the galaxy. Now, the Chinese players are following Black Star. It must be said that it is fate."

"They have started to move. Good, let us look forward to an exciting battle …"

As soon as the battle started, Mad Blade did not plan to fight head-on. A steel cable shot out from the waist of the armor and hooked onto a house below the city wall. With the sound of the high-speed steel cable sliding, he was pulled down and away from the city wall. He took out a large-caliber machine gun in midair, and a series of orange-red bullets were fired at Key of Solomon.

Hum!

Key of Solomon held his bone staff and activated the instant magic rune that was on standby. A translucent turquoise magic shield protected him within. The bullets created dense sparks on the shield. The audience could see that the durability of the shield was decreasing slowly in his status bar.

At this time, Mad Blade had already disappeared between the buildings. Bullets were fired from time to time, and there were also small grenades that exploded on the city wall. Key of Solomon saw this and narrowed his eyes. "Because he is familiar with the terrain, he used the wandering tactic first and used long-range attacks to deplete my health. Humph."

As he spoke, Key of Solomon also jumped down the city wall, took out a few magic scrolls, and tore them open. Magic Radiance of different colors bloomed, and a few UFFs appeared in his status bar.

"Tracking, Stealth, Misdirection, Shadow Demon Cloak, Feign Death …"

"F * ck, this is too expensive. Magic scrolls are so expensive."

The Chinese audience couldn't help but worry for Mad Blade. Although they rarely came into contact with magic, they knew a lot about the effects of magic from the forums.

The radar built into Mad Blade's armor suddenly lost track of the enemy. He frowned. "Magic Stealth. What a troublesome ability. I'm at a disadvantage in terms of detection. It's not good to kite …" With that in mind, he changed the detection properties of the radar and began to detect air disturbances in order to relocate the position of the enemy. The detection range was smaller than before.

The two stealthily tracked each other, attacking and defending each other. Their main goal was to probe each other. Once they found their opponent's weakness or loophole, a thunderous strike would immediately descend. The audience watched the match intently. Their nervousness increased as the distance between the two sides slowly decreased. When the two were moving around, their positioning, setting up traps, and exposing their weaknesses were all meticulous operations. It was commonly known as a battle of wits and courage with the air.

"Huff, huff …"

Muffled panting echoed in the helmet. Mad Blade hid behind a house and observed the tactical screen. The traces of air disturbances appeared in his field of vision, showing a blue snake-like line. The end of the line was the position of the enemy. Mad Blade was good at close combat, but he chose to distance himself. According to Key of Solomon's information, the enemy was not as fragile as other Mages. Many close combat Martialists lost miserably because they rashly closed in. Mad Blade's plan was to find an opportunity to launch a sneak attack and use a combo to control the enemy and deal full damage.

Although he had an invincible trump card, Mad Blade would not use it rashly. If he could win with his own ability, the Character Summon Card that he saved could be used the next time he faced a strong enemy.

His Magic Shield has a time limit and consumes his mana. I still have a lot of ammunition. I can consume about 28% of his mana and about 15% of his health …

With this thought in mind, Mad Blade fired at the enemy's position and hit the Magic Shield. However, at this moment, a new UFF suddenly popped up in his status bar — [Marked].

Reverse Retaliation Mark! Mad Blade knew that this was not good. This skill was rare, and it was the first time the opponent had used it. The previous information did not mention this. The effect was very simple. When attacking the opponent, he would be located, and the opponent's attacks within a certain period of time would automatically track the enemy. This was a spell used to deal with sneak attacks and sneak attacks.

The next moment, the burning sensation quickly approached.

Boom!!

A Frost Fireball blasted through the house that Mad Blade was hiding in, turning the environment into a sea of blue fire. Key of Solomon slowly walked over from afar with an expressionless face. He was a Demon Mage, cultivating both ice and fire. He fused the two to form Frost Fire Stream.

The function of Magic Fusion was like the self-created blueprint of the Mechanic class. The difference was that the success rate of Magic Fusion was higher, but the EXP consumption was also higher. The fusion mechanism was to mix two or more spells into one to obtain a new effect. It required specific casting materials. For example, to form Frost Fireball, one needed the spells [Frost], [Large Fireball], and the material [Fire Trapping Ice Crystal]. The spells used to fuse would be forgotten. If one wanted to learn the original skills again, one would have to separate the new skills after the fusion, and the other would have to find someone to spend EXP to learn it again.

The special characteristic of Frost Fire was to quickly deplete the durability of metals. It was the best way to deal with Mechanics.

Chi chi chi …

At this moment, a magical halo appeared on the surface of Frenzied Sword's NCO Class armor. The jumping frost flames were repelled, and the speed of the armor's durability dropping rapidly slowed down. The enchantment from the Volga brothers gave his armor a certain level of magic resistance.

We can't defend against those Psychic orphans, but we can defend against you Mages!

Mad Blade's leg armor stomped on the ground, and the propulsion device on his back emitted blue flames. His power increased exponentially, and he charged forward like a rhinoceros. A huge foldable alloy shield popped out of his left arm armor, enough to protect his entire body. His right hand pulled out a short metal rod embedded in his waist armor. The short rod automatically lengthened and turned into a long and thin spear.

He instantly entered melee mode!

The alloy shield slammed onto the magic shield. The force was so great that Key of Solomon was forced to take two steps back. This time, Mad Blade saw the opportunity and stabbed his spear into the magic shield. A Compressed Explosive Bullet slid into the barrel of the spear. The next moment, a violent explosion was released from the tip of the spear and exploded inside the magic shield!

Boom!

Black smoke spread out, and flames danced!

"What a beautiful attack! A Mechanical Pugilist's tactics are ever-changing, and Frenzied Sword has changed his weapon again. Speaking of which, he hasn't used the same weapon in any of the individual battles … "a commentator said 'nice'.

"Wait, the damage is very low. It doesn't seem to have hit him completely!"

In the black smoke, Key of Solomon's figure had already disappeared. What replaced it was a stone brick that had turned into powder. His original body appeared fifteen meters behind Mad Blade, and he did not suffer much damage.

"Oh, he used Object Replacement on himself in an emergency. This skill has a very long cooldown of five minutes. Looks like Key of Solomon is very careful about protecting his health. That makes sense. After all, Mad Blade is equipped with a mechanical suit, and his health is almost 1.7 times that of Key of Solomon."

After the stealth was broken, the two of them entered a tug of war. Mad Blade kept poking at Key of Solomon, and Key of Solomon kited him with Frostfire. The two of them fought back and forth passionately. It looked like they were evenly matched, but the status bar showed that Mad Blade was at a disadvantage. His health was dropping faster. When two professional players fought, they naturally did not attack from the same spot. They used exquisite dodging skills. Obviously, Key of Solomon's skills were slightly better.

However, it seemed like the situation was on Mad Blade's side. He was fully armored, and his health was too high. He would be able to exhaust the opponent to death.

However, the commentary was not optimistic.

"Mad Blade's health is 80%, and his armor durability is 66%. Key of Solomon's health is 73%, his magic shield is 31%, and his mana is 68%. The situation is actually very disadvantageous for Mad Blade. Although he has a lot of health, if his armor durability is depleted, his combat power will drop by at least half! He only has one set of armor, and as long as the opponent has mana, he can create a new magic shield at any time. "

Boom!

Frostfire exploded. This time, there was a knockback effect. Mad Blade was forced back a few steps. Key of Solomon backed away. His eyes flashed as he thought to himself, "Not bad.

I underestimated him a little, but it won't affect the result. "

Taking advantage of this opportunity, Key of Solomon chanted a strange demon language. It was like a low murmur. His eyes seemed to be burning, and from the gaps of his scales, countless blue flames surged out. His body suddenly expanded, and he turned into a demon with blue flames. A new UFF was added to his status bar.

Demon Talent — True Name Liberation, Primary Stage!

All attributes increased by 13%! Lasted for ten minutes! Health and mana were restored by 30%! Removed all current UFF (including buffs)!

Immediately after, he took a deep breath. The surrounding flames turned into a burning airflow and were sucked into his mouth. He had an additional 20% of fake health. [Fire Excitement], and his health reached 120% instantly.

The commentator said excitedly, "It's here, it's here! The talent skill of the Demon race! The cooldown time is three days. Among all the regular races on the novice planets, the talent of the Demon race is the most suitable for actual combat. They are born with self-strengthening skills. It's very sick! "

Rumble — —

The situation fell to rock bottom. Frostfire bombarded, and Mad Blade was ravaged like a storm. The opponent's magic power increased greatly, and his health was overflowing. It was equivalent to him losing so much durability and health for nothing. Key of Solomon continued to cast his magic combo step by step, not giving him any chance. He was calm.

Just like his prediction before the match, this was a match without any suspense. There was no need to use his trump cards.

The Chinese audience was shocked. Looking at the pathetic Mad Blade on the screen, they became depressed.

"Oh no, there's no way to fight!"

"It's over already."

"The Americans are really lucky to have chosen Winterfrost as the opening. All the Demon race has this sick skill. They're all like bosses."

The heat passed through the armor. Mad Blade smiled bitterly inside the helmet.

"Damn, I really can't beat him. No wonder he's the captain of a big club …"

With his own skills and combat power, the hope of beating Key of Solomon was very slim.

However …

He was not alone.

"Although I can't beat you, you're nothing compared to me!" Mad Blade clenched his teeth and played his trump card.

Character Summon Card — Black Star's Arrival!

Buzz!

A four-meter-tall translucent shadow suddenly appeared behind Mad Blade. It was dressed in black, and the audience was very familiar with its appearance. Who else could it be other than Han Xiao?

"Isn't that Black Phantom?" The audience was surprised.

The tall shadow was expressionless. He slowly reached out his hand and pressed on Mad Blade's head.

Zap zap zap!

Dazzling lightning suddenly lit up. The rampaging Mechanical Force flowed through the shadow's palm and entered Mad Blade's body. The next moment, Mad Blade was surrounded by lightning.

"What skill is this … What the f * ck!" Before the commentator could react, the next scene almost made his eyeballs pop out.

Frenzied Sword stabbed out with his spear, and Key of Solomon's newly created magic shield was destroyed in one hit!

It was as fragile as a bubble.

Immediately after, Mad Blade closed in and smashed his shield into Key of Solomon's shocked face.

Bang!

The Demon flew out like a cannonball and crashed into a house. His HP dropped by twenty-one percent!

Just one slap from the shield took away more than one-sixth of his HP! His fake HP was gone! The super bonus directly dealt suppressive damage!

In an instant, the situation was reversed!

The scene quieted down. Only the crackling sound of flames and the sizzling sound of electric snakes could be heard.

The audience hurriedly looked at the status bar and was dumbfounded.

[Black Star's Arrival]: + 247% Machinery Affinity. Lasts for three minutes — From Character Summon Card — Han Xiao

"This — this …"

The commentator opened his mouth and was momentarily at a loss for words. He could only squeeze out a sentence.

"Insane!"
